introHtml: Custom kraft dispensary containers offer a natural, eco-friendly look that stands out in retail settings. The brown kraft material conveys a handcrafted, organic feel ideal for cannabis and wellness brands. These containers accept screen printing or label decoration, allowing your logo to pop against the earthy background. Bulk buyers often choose kraft for its recyclability and consistent performance with child-resistant lids.
